claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing robustness verification methods rely on overly conservative assumptions or are computationally prohibitive. ST-Bench provides a realistic, constrained perturbation model for video inputs, enabling tighter approximations and more meaningful robustness comparisons for safety-critical applications.
